messages:
Pri (New Hire): Morning all - first day! Quick question: I need to bootstrap dev env but my company laptop arrives tomorrow. Can I use a personal Linux box temporarily? Concerned about SSH key handling and VPN.
Dana (People Ops): Welcome Pri :tada: Short answer: web-only access is fine. For cloning private repos or VPN we prefer a loaner or a signed BYOD waiver. Want me to open a loaner request?
Pri (New Hire): Yes please. Also I have a personal YubiKey I use for other accounts - can I register that as my FIDO2 factor in Okta?
Noor (Security): Welcome! Personal FIDO2 tokens are allowed if registered in Okta and protected with a PIN. We prefer company-managed keys long term but personal is OK for onboarding. Important: do NOT generate or store company SSH private keys on cloud-synced folders on personal machines.
it-bot: Loaner request created: IT-6724. Courier ETA: tomorrow AM.
Pri (New Hire): Thanks. For SSH best practice: generate keys on the loaner and add the public key to GitHub/our git server?
Noor (Security): Correct. Generate keys on the company device and keep the private key there. If you must use personal for a short window, request an ephemeral deploy key scoped to the specific repo (IT can mint a 24-48h deploy key) and rotate it after use.
security-bot: Security training assigned: "Onboarding: Security Essentials" - due in 72h. New joiners are auto-exempt from PhishSim for the first 7 days.
Dana (People Ops): DMing BYOD waiver (form BYOD-2026-4) + YubiKey enrollment steps and pickup options.
Pri (New Hire): Awesome, will wait for the loaner and register my YubiKey once I have access. Thanks everyone!
